title: Luxora Nova
descriptor: Five trading divisions. One clear route to supply.
challenge: Make a broad electronics wholesale offer easy for business buyers to understand, from computer systems and mobile devices to home appliances and commercial brokerage.
idea: Organize the experience around five trading divisions, with a consistent route from the first introduction to a relevant service page and quote request.
execution: A multi-page company website combines a navy and orange visual identity, a division-led homepage, individual service pages, company information and direct enquiry options.
result: A coherent digital presentation that lets prospective buyers explore the product scope, understand the company and reach its trade desk.

details.title: Five divisions, clearly signposted.
details.body: A dedicated route for each trading division helps visitors find the relevant supply category without working through an undifferentiated list.

details.title: Technology with a clear commercial focus.
details.body: A fine grid, dark blue surfaces, bold white type and orange actions connect the technology offer with an orderly business-facing interface.

details.title: Context before the conversation.
details.body: The About page brings the company story, operating location and trading scope into a single readable profile.

details.title: From division to quote request.
details.body: Service and contact links recur throughout the experience, giving buyers a direct next step after exploring the offer.

title: Velox Energy
descriptor: Energy trading, presented with purpose and precision.
challenge: Explain a multi-category energy trading business to counterparties who need to understand product scope, operating approach and how to make an enquiry.
idea: Build the story around the trading desk: what it trades, how a cargo moves and where a prospective partner starts a conversation.
execution: A dark editorial website pairs large typography and industrial photography with four commodity lines, a staged operating process, a company profile and trade contact routes.
result: A focused online introduction that connects the company's positioning to its commodity range and trade-enquiry path.

details.title: Energy, in motion.
details.body: Large white and amber lettering over refinery imagery gives the opening a strong identity, supported by restrained labels and clear navigation.

details.title: Four lines, one desk.
details.body: Crude oil, petroleum products, lubricants and grease, and trading abroad are organized into distinct sections with supporting product information.

details.title: From source to settlement.
details.body: The homepage explains sourcing, trade structure, shipping and settlement as an ordered sequence, making the operating approach easier to follow.

details.title: A clear start to the trade conversation.
details.body: Prominent Start a trade actions connect the introduction and product information to the dedicated contact page.

title: Nexus Oil
descriptor: A detailed trading offer with a distinctive digital identity.
challenge: Present a technical petroleum trading offer with enough structure for visitors to navigate products, operational services and enquiry requirements.
idea: Pair a memorable opening with detailed, clearly grouped information about product families, cargo processes and company context.
execution: The site combines fluid oil-inspired visuals, oversized typography, photographic service sections, a detailed company profile and a dedicated trading-desk contact page.
result: A connected company and service presentation that supports both a quick introduction and a deeper read before making a cargo enquiry.

details.title: A material reference made digital.
details.body: The dark, fluid hero references the product itself, while amber actions and spacious typography keep the navigation and message visible.

details.title: Product families with room for detail.
details.body: The services experience separates fuel categories and lubricants, placing product descriptions and operational context within a clear hierarchy.

details.title: A cargo journey, step by step.
details.body: An ordered sequence on the homepage explains the stages between an initial enquiry and delivery, supporting the site's operational focus.

details.title: A direct route to the trading desk.
details.body: Company details and a dedicated contact destination give visitors a way to move from reading the offer to starting a relevant conversation.

title: EQUIPO
descriptor: Industrial capability, organized for the next enquiry.
challenge: Bring equipment supply, engineering support and industrial services together in a website that serves several kinds of business buyer.
idea: Use an industrial visual language and a clear service structure to connect company capability, service detail and contact options.
execution: A red, black and white company website combines industrial photography, a service directory, individual service pages, company information and enquiry routes.
result: A substantial business website that gives prospective customers multiple ways to understand the offer and contact the company.

details.title: A recognizable industrial presence.
details.body: Bold red accents, condensed type and workshop photography give the website a consistent equipment and engineering character.

details.title: A directory built around practical needs.
details.body: Equipment supply, custom solutions, automation and technical support appear as separate services with dedicated detail pages.

details.title: Capabilities beyond the catalogue.
details.body: The About page presents the company's supply and support approach alongside its industrial experience.

details.title: Keep the next step visible.
details.body: Quote prompts and contact information sit alongside the main navigation, with a dedicated contact page for enquiries.

title: IENSOL
descriptor: A technical catalogue built around product discovery.
challenge: Help visitors navigate a wide scientific and industrial equipment range while keeping product enquiries and support within reach.
idea: Put discovery first: combine category navigation, keyword search, product browsing and clearly labeled enquiry actions.
execution: A yellow, black and white catalogue website connects category-led navigation, product listings, individual product pages, company information and contact routes.
result: A product-focused digital destination that supports browsing across instrument categories and moving from a selected item toward an enquiry.

details.title: Several ways to find the right instrument.
details.body: Category navigation and product search give buyers different starting points, whether they know the instrument family or a specific product name.

details.title: Technical range, organized into categories.
details.body: The catalogue groups analytical instruments, petroleum testing and other equipment families into a navigable product hierarchy.

details.title: From listing to enquiry.
details.body: Product cards lead to dedicated detail pages and enquiry actions, keeping the next step connected to the item being considered.

details.title: A consistent frame for a broad range.
details.body: A clear yellow and black navigation system ties together the catalogue, company profile and sales-and-service contact information.
